evidence.supporting_excerpt: Misapplying "parts of general use" rules. Note 2 to Section XV and Note 1(g) to Section XVII define "parts of general use" - standardized articles like screws, bolts, nuts... Even when these items are sold specifically for automotive applications, they are classified under their material-based chapter (typically Chapter 73 for steel fasteners) rather than Chapter 87.
